files.notes: Pure success/failure log formatter; connection/status fields present on both, deadlines/class only on failure. Values supplied by shared client telemetry, not measured here.
Optional DeepSeek balance GET; fixed public URL, bearer auth, 10s timeout, 64KiB body ceiling, parses first currency balance. IsAvailable is decoded but unused; not decision-path risk balance.

Provider hooks control URL/auth/body/nonstream parsing. Simple and Request/full paths retry separately; planner SSE adds total/idle contexts, storm counter and telemetry. SSE parser only understands OpenAI deltas. Empty EOF is success; nonstream TTFB measurement begins too late. Shared atomics avoid torn words but not per-call mixing. See report for traced limitations.

Environment/default resolution plus SSRF-safe HTTP client. Canonical HTTP timeout overrides legacy timeout; positive-int resolver prevents zero retries via environment. Stream tries clamped 1..6, positive duration schedule. Explicit-set flags test presence, not validity.

Rune-count/3 plus per-message overhead heuristic; drops oldest non-system messages but retains at least one and cannot fit oversized system or final message. Any variant omits tools/reasoning from estimate and can break tool/result pairing.

Sentinels outrank HTTP status, which outranks message sniffing; 429 classified retryable HTTP5xx. Parse is model-side, empty/deadline/transport/too-long provider-side. Classification requires error, does not detect successful empty parser output.
Provider dynamic dispatch contract for body, request, auth, URL, parsers and retry. SSE parser is not an overridable hook.

Seven-method AIClient includes exact ResolvedModel; ClientEmbedder supports base access and ThinkingTuner applies model overrides. Inherited SetThinking exists on all embedded clients, but injection is DeepSeek-only.
Printf logging interface and no-op implementation for test injection.
Only deepseek/qwen/minimax bare aliases recognized, lower/trimmed; returns empty for other identifiers.

Functional config setters; WithTimeout mutates current HTTPClient, hence option order and nil clients matter. Convenience provider options bundle URL/model. Injected HTTP clients bypass default SSRF protections.

Payment gateway registry and model-route selection; private key configured via SetAPIKey; estimates wallet preflight cost but RPC failures proceed. Overrides simple Call and RequestFull for payment; inherited Request/stream entrypoints do not perform payment handshake. Claude proxy changes body/parse format. Unknown models silently use default route while Model remains input.

402 header -> first accept option -> EIP712 signing -> up to five signed retries. Context propagates on RequestFull. Stream idle starts after payment handshake and resets on all lines. Partial text wins over SSE errors. Dynamic asset address lacks length check; arbitrary payment demands not bounded by preflight estimate.

Bounded env watchdog pre/post, stream storm cap, trace switch and boot policy text; post override is min(default,positive override). Observed keepalive explicitly unavailable. Constants report resend enabled and executor serialization absent.

Anthropic request/response conversion with x-api-key/version header and /messages. Last system message wins; Request MaxTokens ignored in favor of Client cap. Consecutive tool results grouped, assistant content discarded when tool calls exist, last text response block wins. Inherited SSE remains OpenAI-only.

Provider identifiers and core defaults used without subpackage import cycle.
Init-time global factory map; unknown provider nil. No synchronization for late registration; expected startup-only ownership.
Message/tool/request/response data contracts plus role constructors. Ctx excluded from JSON. ToolChoice string cannot represent a native object directly.

Fluent request accumulation; optional pointer params preserve zero; clamped temperature, range filtering for others. Build validates only nonempty messages and aliases slices/pointers. Presets specify output caps.

httptrace connection/dial observations plus inferred close reason. Generic read errors called peer_fin unless named local sentinel; caller cancellation can therefore be mislabeled. Dial hooks share non-atomic fields.

Warn-only served-slice horizon telemetry; counts before dedupe, 10m boot empty grace, 15m key window and session-day reset. Caller stack skips own shims; wrappers remain honestly named. Boot line reads cache depths.

Process-once writer, closed/open timestamp conversion, contract ACK/store fallback stamp, replay hold, boot flush, 1m-only older rehydrate and retention/integrity loop. Roll/scale hooks installed only after boot flush. Store errors warn without disabling trading. Aggregate kept/filtered counts repeated on per-symbol boot lines.

Singleton installs market.FuturesBarsProvider; tail selection then Bar -> Kline with scheduled CloseTime and horizon warning. Unknown duration returns zero but output CloseTime is OpenTime-1. No freshness refusal at this layer.

Once-per-instance subscriptions consume account/symbol close and reject streams; owner lookup across traders, row-quantity point-value PnL, deterministic exit fill, corrected PnL and post-exit callback. Unmatched closes parked, no fabrication. Close-confirmed wall time stamped after processing, independent of DB success.

Pure contract/source census log renderers plus live assembly. Store fallback labeled; unknown fact n/a. Census read error silently becomes zero map, and live source census does not enumerate historical_import.

Per-trader nightly job evaluates previous CME session from persisted MNQ 1m contract-filtered bars and latest plan per NY/ASIA/LONDON; dedup price+label. Four attempts with 15s waits. Backfill mistakenly uses midnight rather than declared 17:00 start; all traders use MNQ.
32 confirmed fill ring; latest opposite side in firstFlat-25s..now recovers price. Receipt clock fallback for invalid fill time; quantity/entry identity not used to prove exact flattening fill.

Per-TCPTrader instance 55s duplicate and 10-actions/60s limiter. Records admission before downstream validation/send. Key prefixes distinguish market/limit/stop; not global account limiter. lastSeen never pruned.
Process-global account/symbol/side latest unmatched close cache, consumed once within 120s. Does not use saved quantity, entry identity or lower time bound; expired entries deleted only on take.

20s process-lived reconcile, positive snapshot required but no age check here; 120s entry/60s flat/60s untracked grace. Corrects held entry average, freezes persisted qty divergence, recovers parked/netting exits else unresolved. Accountless lookup can suppress another account row; lineage matching uses side+price without event time.

Mutex-protected symbol/tf replay queue capped at 2x ring; sorted latest timestamp wins, newest tail retained. Ring verdict releases or discards. Rows removed before insert; failed insert is not retried. No replay generation key.

SIM+bound-account TCP adapter, signal UUIDs and pending fill correlation, local SL/TP setters, limit/stop/protective send and asynchronous close. Balance fallback can read another account; reset maps use wrong lock; order status ignores requested orderID and partial status. No adapter boot latch at reviewed base (parent repair separate).
Independent exact-case instrument tick table and nearest rounding; unknown defaults 0.25. Distinct from market.FuturesTickSize, so input canonicalization/table parity are necessary.

Legacy CSV adapter default when NT_TRANSPORT unset: local brackets, midpoint reference, tailer goroutine, mocked 50k balance; no meaningful closes/cancels/current market quote. Not live NT8 TCP architecture.

Lazy process-singleton TCP server and futures bridge; cached startup error never retried. Config first nonempty symbol primary, extras per source and env additions. CSV default, TCP opt-in. Snapshot sink intended before construction.
